claims.claim: File a written response with the court.
claims.quote: A direction that the defendant file with the court a written pleading in response to the complaint within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The statute specifies a written pleading.

claims.claim: File the response with the court clerk.
claims.quote: file with the court a written pleading
claims.note: The filing direction identifies the court, not specifically the clerk.

claims.quote: within 30 days after summons is served on the defendant.
claims.note: The draft does not give a specific number of days.

claims.claim: A general denial is allowed when the complaint is unverified.
claims.quote: If the complaint is subject to Article 2 (commencing with Section 90) of Chapter 5.1 of Title 1 of Part 1 or is not verified, a general denial is sufficient but only puts in issue the material allegations of the complaint.
claims.note: This supports the type of denial, not eligibility to use a particular form.

claims.claim: PLD-050 is the short general denial form.
claims.note: The form text was not supplied.

claims.claim: PLD-050 may be used in any unverified limited civil case.
claims.note: The statute does not establish the form's eligibility conditions.

claims.claim: The limited civil amount-in-controversy ceiling is $35,000, inclusive.
claims.quote: (a) The amount in controversy does not exceed thirty-five thousand dollars ($35,000).
claims.note: The statutory amount excludes attorneys’ fees, interest, and costs.

claims.claim: A claim of $35,000 or less is, by that fact alone, a limited civil case.
claims.quote: an action or special proceeding shall be treated as a limited civil case only if all of the following conditions are satisfied:
claims.note: The dollar ceiling is necessary but not sufficient; subdivisions (b) and (c) also restrict the relief sought.

claims.claim: If unable to afford the filing fee, ask for a fee waiver.
claims.note: No fee-waiver eligibility or request instructions were supplied.

claims.claim: Use form FW-001 to request the fee waiver.
claims.note: The named form was not supplied.

flags.text: “Any” extends a rule about general denials to PLD-050. The draft's citation note mentions assigned claims over $1,000, but the missing form prevents checking the restriction or its conditions.
Relying on unchecked form eligibility could lead to a defective response and risk default.
The definition of a limited civil case omits the relief requirements in §85(b) and (c).
The fee-waiver instruction and form number lack source text; the filing statute also does not identify the clerk as the filing recipient.
“File” and “ask for a fee waiver” direct the reader to take procedural steps.

result.summary: The statutes support timely filing with the court, general denials for unverified complaints, and the $35,000 ceiling. They do not establish PLD-050 eligibility or the FW-001 instructions, and the ceiling alone does not determine limited civil status.
